name: SIMBA
install:
bash -s << 'EOF'
set -euo pipefail
if [ -f .cursor/install.sh ]; then
  bash .cursor/install.sh
  exit 0
fi
if ! python3 -c 'import ensurepip' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo -n apt-get update
  sudo -n apt-get install -y python3-venv || sudo -n apt-get install -y python3.12-venv
fi
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/python -m pip install -U pip
.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt 'claude-agent-sdk>=0.1.0' 'google-api-python-client>=2.100.0' 'google-auth>=2.23.0' 'google-auth-oauthlib>=1.1.0' 'google-auth-httplib2>=0.1.1' 'pywebpush>=1.14.0' 'py-vapid>=1.9.0' 'mss>=9.0.0'
EOF
start:
bash -s << 'EOF' set -euo pipefail if [ -f .cursor/start.sh ]; then bash .cursor/start.sh exit 0 fi REPO="$(pwd)" ROOT="${SIMBA_DEV_ROOT:-$HOME/simba-dev}" export SIMBA_DEV_ROOT="$ROOT" export SIMBA_TOKEN="${SIMBA_TOKEN:-dev-simba-token}" export OBSERVER_ENABLED="${OBSERVER_ENABLED:-false}" export PYTHONPATH="$ROOT${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}" mkdir -p "$ROOT/simba" "$ROOT/pwa" "$ROOT/data" "$ROOT/workspace" if ! mountpoint -q "$ROOT/simba"; then sudo -n mount --bind "$REPO" "$ROOT/simba" fi if [ ! -f "$ROOT/pwa/index.html" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'SIMBA

SIMBA

Servidor local.

' > "$ROOT/pwa/index.html" fi cd "$ROOT" "$REPO/.venv/bin/python" -c 'import simba.server; print("simba server import ok")' EOF

terminals.name: simba-server
terminals.command:
bash -s << 'EOF' set -euo pipefail if [ -f .cursor/dev-server.sh ]; then bash .cursor/dev-server.sh exit 0 fi REPO="$(pwd)" ROOT="${SIMBA_DEV_ROOT:-$HOME/simba-dev}" export SIMBA_DEV_ROOT="$ROOT" export SIMBA_TOKEN="${SIMBA_TOKEN:-dev-simba-token}" export OBSERVER_ENABLED="${OBSERVER_ENABLED:-false}" export PYTHONPATH="$ROOT${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}" mkdir -p "$ROOT/simba" "$ROOT/pwa" "$ROOT/data" "$ROOT/workspace" if ! mountpoint -q "$ROOT/simba"; then sudo -n mount --bind "$REPO" "$ROOT/simba" fi if [ ! -f "$ROOT/pwa/index.html" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'SIMBA

SIMBA

' > "$ROOT/pwa/index.html" fi cd "$ROOT" exec "$REPO/.venv/bin/python" -m uvicorn simba.server:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 EOF
terminals.description: SIMBA FastAPI server on port 8000. Local token defaults to dev-simba-token. Screen observer is off unless OBSERVER_ENABLED=true.
